compactification.title: Hidden Dimensions
texts: Field notes, the Bulk. The extra dimensions are mined here: $(item)Kaluza-Klein$() everywhere, $(item)Dilaton$() on the Graviton Reefs, $(item)Moduli$() in the Moduli Wastes.

Fauna: $(thing)Brane Striders$() drop $(item)Brane Tension Fiber$(); $(thing)Graviton Wisps$() drop their cores. Both are worth hunting.$(br2)Background: string theory needs 10 dimensions (M-theory 11). The extras are $(thing)compactified$() - curled up too small to see, and their shape fixes the laws of physics we observe.

The $(item)Compactification Lathe$() turns the ores into $(item)Compactified Circles$(), $(item)D-Brane Sheets$() and - with an octonion - $(item)G₂ Manifolds$().$(br2)Membranes are now made from those, and the $(item)M-Theory Core$() unites all eleven dimensions.
Rolls extra dimensions up small: Kaluza-Klein circles, Calabi-Yau and G₂ spaces, D-branes and finally M-theory itself.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

In 1921 Kaluza found that general relativity in five dimensions yields Maxwell's equations for free; Klein explained the fifth as a tiny circle. String theory uses six-dimensional $(thing)Calabi-Yau$() shapes, M-theory seven-dimensional $(thing)G₂$() ones. Here they come out of a lathe.
Quantises gravity itself - gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality. The problem physics has failed at for a century.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

The $(thing)graviton$() is the hypothetical massless spin-2 particle carrying gravity, never detected; one would be absurdly hard to catch. $(thing)Spin foam$() comes from loop quantum gravity, where spacetime itself is a network of discrete quanta. The $(item)Graviton Condenser$() treats both as feedstock.

multiverse_rift.title: Multiverse Rift
texts: Holds open a tear into neighbouring universes and harvests what leaks through. I keep the lights low around it.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
Note to self: this controller is too complex for a crafting grid. It has to be built on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts before ordering anything.
Harvest log. Each harvest pulls matter from universes whose physical constants differ slightly from ours, including $(item)Multiverse Shards$() and $(fluid)Inflaton Field$().

Context: eternal inflation and the string landscape (perhaps 10^500 possible vacua) both suggest other universes with other constants. None is reachable in our physics. The $(item)Multiverse Rift Stabilizer$() disagrees.
Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

Two very different 'strings'. A $(thing)cosmic string$() is a hypothetical crack in spacetime left by the early universe, light-years long and thinner than a proton. A $(thing)fundamental string$() is string theory's basic object: each vibration mode is a particle. The $(item)String Resonance Loom$() turns one into the other.
Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow - and later harvest - a pocket universe. I have never been more nervous.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
Note to self: this controller is too complex for a crafting grid. It has to be built on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts before ordering anything.

A $(thing)false vacuum$() is a metastable state; if it decays, a bubble of true vacuum expands at nearly light speed. $(thing)Inflation$(), driven by the inflaton field, stretched our universe by a factor of at least 10^26 in a fraction of a second. Combine them and you get a universe in a box.

Procedure: first forge a $(item)Pocket Universe$() from a $(item)Universe Seed$(), $(fluid)False Vacuum$() and $(fluid)Inflaton Field$(). Then feed it back in to harvest it until only a $(item)Heat Death Remnant$() remains.$(br2)Four remnants can be re-inflated into a new seed. Nothing is wasted, not even the end of time.
